notes.title: Global Leaderboards Update!
notes.content:
Hello Party Smashers!

We are thrilled to see so many of you out there playing Smash Party.   It has been amazing to finally get to share it with all of you and to see so many people out there playing.  Big thanks to everybody who has given the game a try, made a Let's Play video for it, and/or given us some feedback about the game.  Today we have our first update:

Smash Party VR 1.1:

1)  Added Global Leaderboards
2)  Removed grip functionality to change song (some people were pressing it inadvertently)
3)  Fixed some layering glitches with the scoreboards


Thanks again for playing and we look forward to seeing what kinds of scores you guys can rack up.
